title: YouTube Shorts Thumbnails Now Available
summary: The `ThumbnailDetails` schema now includes a new `shortsAspectRatio` property, providing access to 9:16 aspect ratio thumbnails specifically for YouTube Shorts. This allows developers to better display Shorts content.
details: A new property, `shortsAspectRatio`, has been added to the `schemas.ThumbnailDetails` object. This property is of type `Thumbnail` and is described as 'The Shorts aspect ratio (9:16) image for this resource.' Developers can now retrieve specific thumbnails optimized for the vertical 9:16 aspect ratio used by YouTube Shorts, improving the presentation of Shorts content in their applications.
